catalog.angular.description.es: Configuracion de comandos Angular organizada por areas funcionales en un unico archivo.
catalog.angular.description.en: Angular command configuration organized by functional areas in a single file.

groups.groups.angularCoreWorkflow.description.e: Comandos base del CLI de Angular para inicializacion, configuracion y tareas globales.
Core Angular CLI commands for initialization, configuration, and global tasks.

commands.commands.ngVersion.description.es: Muestra la version instalada de Angular CLI, Angular y dependencias relacionadas del workspace actual.
commands.commands.ngVersion.description.en: Displays the installed version of Angular CLI, Angular, and related dependencies in the current workspace.

commands.commands.ngNewMyApp.description.es: Crea un nuevo proyecto Angular llamado my-app con la estructura base inicial.
commands.commands.ngNewMyApp.description.en: Creates a new Angular project named my-app with the initial base structure.

commands.commands.ngCacheClean.description.es: Limpia la cache local utilizada por Angular CLI para compilaciones y tareas internas.
commands.commands.ngCacheClean.description.en: Clears the local cache used by Angular CLI for builds and internal tasks.

commands.commands.ngAnalyticsOff.description.es: Desactiva el envio de datos de analitica de uso de Angular CLI.
commands.commands.ngAnalyticsOff.description.en: Disables Angular CLI usage analytics data collection.

commands.commands.ngConfig.description.es: Consulta o modifica la configuracion definida en angular.json o en la configuracion global del CLI.
commands.commands.ngConfig.description.en: Reads or updates the configuration defined in angular.json or the global CLI configuration.

groups.groups.angularDevelopment.description.es: Comandos para desarrollo diario, compilacion, pruebas y ciclo local de trabajo.
groups.groups.angularDevelopment.description.en: Commands for daily development, builds, testing, and local workflow.

subgroups.subgroups.angularBuildRunTest.descriptio: Serve, build, test, lint, e2e e internacionalizacion.
Serve, build, test, lint, e2e, and internationalization commands.

commands.commands.ngServe.description.es: Levanta el servidor de desarrollo local de Angular y recompila automaticamente ante cambios.
commands.commands.ngServe.description.en: Starts the local Angular development server and rebuilds automatically on changes.

commands.commands.ngBuild.description.es: Compila la aplicacion Angular y genera los artefactos de salida en la carpeta dist.
commands.commands.ngBuild.description.en: Builds the Angular application and generates output artifacts in the dist folder.

commands.commands.ngBuildProduction.description.e: Compila la aplicacion utilizando la configuracion de produccion definida en el workspace.
Builds the application using the production configuration defined in the workspace.

commands.commands.ngTest.description.es: Ejecuta los tests unitarios del proyecto Angular mediante el runner configurado.
commands.commands.ngTest.description.en: Runs the Angular project's unit tests using the configured runner.

commands.commands.ngLint.description.es: Analiza el codigo fuente del proyecto para detectar errores de estilo y reglas de calidad.
commands.commands.ngLint.description.en: Analyzes the project source code to detect style issues and quality rule violations.

commands.commands.ngE2e.description.es: Lanza las pruebas end-to-end configuradas para validar flujos completos de la aplicacion.
commands.commands.ngE2e.description.en: Runs the configured end-to-end tests to validate complete application flows.

commands.commands.ngExtractI18n.description.es: Extrae los mensajes internacionalizables de la aplicacion para su traduccion.
commands.commands.ngExtractI18n.description.en: Extracts translatable messages from the application for localization.

subgroups.subgroups.angularCypress.description.es: Automatizacion de pruebas end-to-end con Cypress en proyectos Angular.
subgroups.subgroups.angularCypress.description.en: End-to-end test automation with Cypress for Angular projects.

commands.commands.cypressOpen.description.es: Abre la interfaz interactiva de Cypress para ejecutar y depurar pruebas end-to-end.
commands.commands.cypressOpen.description.en: Opens the interactive Cypress UI to run and debug end-to-end tests.

commands.commands.cypressRun.description.es: Ejecuta las pruebas de Cypress en modo no interactivo desde linea de comandos.
commands.commands.cypressRun.description.en: Runs Cypress tests in non-interactive mode from the command line.

groups.groups.angularScaffolding.description.es: Generacion de componentes y artefactos para acelerar la creacion de codigo.
groups.groups.angularScaffolding.description.en: Generation of components and artifacts to speed up code creation.

commands.commands.ngGenerateComponentUsersList.de: Genera un nuevo componente Angular en la ruta users/list.
Generates a new Angular component in the users/list path.

commands.commands.ngGenerateServiceCoreApi.descri: Genera un nuevo servicio Angular en la ruta core/api.
Generates a new Angular service in the core/api path.

commands.commands.ngGenerateModuleAdminRouting.de: Genera un nuevo modulo Angular llamado admin con soporte de routing.
Generates a new Angular module named admin with routing support.

commands.commands.ngGenerateGuardAuth.description: Genera un guard de Angular llamado auth para proteger rutas o flujos de navegacion.
Generates an Angular guard named auth to protect routes or navigation flows.

groups.groups.angularWorkspaceManagement.descri: Herramientas para monorepos, dependencias y gestion de espacios de trabajo.
Tools for monorepos, dependencies, and workspace management.

subgroups.subgroups.angularDependencies.descriptio: Instalacion y mantenimiento de dependencias usadas por proyectos Angular.
Installation and maintenance of dependencies used by Angular projects.

commands.commands.ngAddAngularMaterial.descriptio: Instala Angular Material y aplica la configuracion inicial recomendada en el proyecto.
Installs Angular Material and applies the recommended initial project setup.

commands.commands.ngUpdateAngularCoreCli.descript: Actualiza Angular Core y Angular CLI a versiones compatibles dentro del workspace.
Updates Angular Core and Angular CLI to compatible versions within the workspace.

commands.commands.npmInstallRxjs.description.es: Instala la libreria RxJS para trabajar con observables y programacion reactiva en Angular.
commands.commands.npmInstallRxjs.description.en: Installs the RxJS library to work with observables and reactive programming in Angular.

commands.commands.npmInstallNgrxStore.description: Instala NgRx Store para gestion centralizada del estado de la aplicacion.
Installs NgRx Store for centralized application state management.

commands.commands.npmInstallNgrxEffects.descripti: Instala NgRx Effects para manejar efectos secundarios y flujos asincronos.
Installs NgRx Effects to handle side effects and asynchronous flows.

commands.commands.ngAddAngularEslintSchematics.de: Agrega Angular ESLint al proyecto para sustituir o complementar reglas de linting.
Adds Angular ESLint to the project to replace or complement linting rules.

commands.commands.npmInstallCypress.description.e: Instala Cypress como herramienta de pruebas end-to-end para el proyecto.
Installs Cypress as the end-to-end testing tool for the project.

commands.commands.npmInstallJasmineCore.descripti: Instala Jasmine Core como framework base para pruebas unitarias.
Installs Jasmine Core as the base framework for unit testing.

commands.commands.npmInstallKarma.description.es: Instala Karma como test runner para ejecutar pruebas del proyecto Angular.
commands.commands.npmInstallKarma.description.en: Installs Karma as the test runner to execute Angular project tests.

subgroups.subgroups.angularNx.description.es: Comandos para visualizar y ejecutar tareas en workspaces Angular con Nx.
subgroups.subgroups.angularNx.description.en: Commands to visualize and run tasks in Angular workspaces with Nx.

commands.commands.npxNxGraph.description.es: Genera y muestra el grafo de dependencias entre aplicaciones y librerias del workspace Nx.
commands.commands.npxNxGraph.description.en: Generates and displays the dependency graph between applications and libraries in the Nx workspace.

commands.commands.npxNxServeMyApp.description.es: Inicia en modo desarrollo la aplicacion my-app dentro de un workspace Nx.
commands.commands.npxNxServeMyApp.description.en: Starts the my-app application in development mode inside an Nx workspace.

commands.commands.npxNxBuildMyApp.description.es: Compila la aplicacion my-app dentro del workspace Nx.
commands.commands.npxNxBuildMyApp.description.en: Builds the my-app application inside the Nx workspace.

commands.commands.npxNxTestMyApp.description.es: Ejecuta los tests asociados a la aplicacion my-app en el workspace Nx.
commands.commands.npxNxTestMyApp.description.en: Runs the tests associated with the my-app application in the Nx workspace.
